name: coderifts
description: Contract-change authorization for Claude Code — ask before a contract change proceeds, and verify the signed decision offline.

plugins.name: api-governance
plugins.description: Stops an agent's breaking edit to an OpenAPI, GraphQL, protobuf, AsyncAPI or MCP contract until a signed grant exists. The required check on the pull request stays the merge gate.

plugins.name: agent-hooks
plugins.description: Host adapters for CodeRifts: Claude Code PreToolUse asks before Write/Edit of OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, protobuf, or MCP manifest files. Not the GitHub Action (coderifts/contract-gate) and not the guard library (@coderifts/agent-guard).
